name: Upcoming contracts to be awarded (CAP)
description:
This dataset lists upcoming housing and development contracts slated to be awarded, with each row representing a planned project. It includes the project name, borough, geographic district, a short description, budget range, design completion date, project category, status, square footage, and seat count. Projects span all five boroughs, with Brooklyn most heavily represented, and categories include site work, additions, new schools, and leases. Budget ranges run from $500K–$750K up to over $4M, and design completion dates fall in late 2026 and early 2027. The seat count field is entirely empty in the sampled rows, so it offers no usable information.

The data could support tracking the pipeline of planned development projects, comparing budgets and timelines across boroughs or categories, monitoring design milestones and project status, and supporting planning, procurement, or public transparency efforts around upcoming construction and community facilities.
